experiences.title: TREKKING
experiences.description: Cross the legendary Baltoro glacier to Concordia and Gondogoro La pass (5,585m) under the sheer granite spires of Trango Towers.

experiences.title: MOUNTAINEERING
experiences.description: World-standard technical expeditions to K2, Broad Peak, Spantik, and Mont Blanc with fixed-rope rigging, oxygen logistics, and UIAGM leadership.

experiences.title: CAMPING
experiences.description: Engineered four-season dome camps on the 4,114m Deosai plateau and moraines of Fairy Meadows with heated mess tents and solar power.

experiences.title: PHOTOGRAPHY
experiences.tagline: Golden hour foliage & mirrored glacial lakes
experiences.description: Curated itineraries timed for peak apricot blossom and golden autumn reflections at Attabad Lake, Passu Cathedral, and Katpana dunes.

experiences.title: FAMILY ESCAPE
experiences.tagline: Safe, paced mountain wonder for all generations
experiences.description: Gentle acclimatization profiles, five-star Serena heritage palaces, kid-safe day hikes, private 4x4 vehicles, and Silk Road folklore.

experiences.title: LUXURY MOUNTAIN TRAVEL
experiences.description: Helicopter transfers over the Karakoram giants, presidential suites in 400-year-old restored royal forts, private chefs, and bespoke itineraries.

experiences.title: CULTURAL JOURNEY
experiences.tagline: Silk Road heritage, Balti craft & Wakhi melodies
experiences.description: Explore UNESCO heritage restoration sites, ancient Buddhist petroglyphs in Gilgit, centuries-old water channels, and organic apricot cuisine.
